title: Oracle surfaces could overwrite sealed raw inputs
root_cause: Dictionary update let caller replace the raw path with clean content.
existing_test_gap: Only empty or unrelated supplemental surfaces were tested, not a colliding raw path.
fix: Separate sealed_raw and supplemental namespaces; neither overwrites the other.

title: Unbound scoring and invented population metrics
root_cause: Raw retrieval fell through to perfect recall/MRR; answer vocabulary checks ignored frozen GT; caller scoring_fn could supply PASS; absent lanes inherited metrics.
existing_test_gap: Fixtures called arbitrary scoring callbacks and treated status labels as official scoring.
fix: Remove synthetic scoring paths. Persist UNVERIFIED items with empty metrics while the verified frozen GT/runtime adapter is unavailable. Ignore alternate records and scoring callbacks.

title: Caller metrics and unrelated paths passed mandatory gates
root_cause: Thirteen gates adopted caller metrics directly; path existence and fallback paths substituted for measured evidence.
existing_test_gap: Coverage concentrated on B10/B12; happy fixtures supplied every other passing observation.
fix: Return explicit UNVERIFIED results for gates without authoritative producers, with no observations or evidence. Reverify freeze and reject changed threshold bytes.

title: Health phase manufactured PASS without measurements
root_cause: Absent health_payload defaulted to PASS and wrote a provider preflight artifact without checking health or telemetry.
existing_test_gap: Integration fixtures supplied status-only files or accepted the default.
fix: Read typed pre/post health and resource samples/events; recompute health/resource status. Missing measurements are UNVERIFIED. Do not synthesize provider evidence.

title: Placeholder bundle could be promoted as PASS
root_cause: Finalizer accepted caller-selected mandatory registry and status-only artifacts without authoritative metric producers.
existing_test_gap: Nominal successful finalizer fixtures were fake PASS JSON, often with one gate.
fix: Require exact B0-B14 registry for PASS and reject certification while mandatory producers are unverified. Keep non-PASS evidence archiving available.

title: Real evidence index hashes were not checked against files
root_cause: Finalizer verified the digest list hash but never read the indexed evidence bytes; empty indexes also passed.
existing_test_gap: Producer integration tests checked only that a bundle existed.
fix: Require a nonempty complete index and verify every confined referenced file against its hash before promotion. A non-PASS archive regression isolates this check from the PASS blocker.

title: Unchecked extra claims and word overlap false-PASS
root_cause: First matching claim ended the fact loop; a second unsupported claim was never evaluated. Shared context vocabulary was treated as propositional support.
existing_test_gap: Earlier tests appended new vocabulary to one claim; they did not add a second claim or reuse unrelated context words.
fix: Check every claim and require a complete source-linked proposition/span for deterministic support. Unproven paraphrases remain non-PASS; regex matching alone cannot establish support.

title: Mixed identified and unidentified records passed identity checks
root_cause: One run_id anywhere satisfied JSONL file identity; JSON arrays similarly ignored unidentified rows.
existing_test_gap: Tests checked a wrong explicit run_id and completely missing identity, not a mixture.
fix: Require identity per non-allowlisted record in JSON, JSONL and their gzip variants; also check conflicting JSONL metadata identity.

title: Semantically empty material/runtime identity accepted
root_cause: Valid sidecars and category labels could accompany empty bytes or an empty runtime identity.
existing_test_gap: Tests covered missing lists/categories but not nonempty lists pointing to empty material.
fix: Reject empty material files in creation/verification and empty runtime identity in verification.

title: Lifecycle history corruption accepted by a later phase
root_cause: Phase ordering relied on a mutable counter without replaying lifecycle history.
existing_test_gap: Tests called methods out of order, but did not clear lifecycle history at an otherwise valid phase.
fix: Compare completed phases with the phase prefix; replay transitions and require lifecycle status to match the phase. Counter-skip test now diagnoses the phase boundary directly.

title: Raw and oracle records accepted foreign run identity
root_cause: Checksums/manifests were checked without requiring raw and oracle run_id to equal the store run.
existing_test_gap: Earlier tests mutated content without resealing, so checksum errors masked missing identity checks.
fix: Validate raw object/run identity during manifest construction and oracle run identity before scoring.

title: Production verdict API trusted caller gate registry
root_cause: A caller-selected B10-only registry and fabricated COMPLETED manifest produced PROFILE_B_PASS_NATIVE.
existing_test_gap: Tests exercised the transaction wrapper or injected a failing gate; they did not invoke the public production verdict function with a reduced registry.
fix: Require exact B0-B14 registry and refuse a PASS claim without registered authoritative metric producers.

title: Oracle/score mutation after scoring accepted by gates
root_cause: Gate phase validated summary and raw manifest but not current oracle audit, score-report bytes/count, or scorer source hash.
existing_test_gap: Tests mutated only the score summary or raw files.
fix: Revalidate passing oracle and exact audit hash, actual serialized score-report hash/count, and scorer hash before gates.

title: Evidence path aliases bypassed uniqueness
root_cause: Duplicate detection compared strings, so artifact.json and ./artifact.json counted separately.
existing_test_gap: Duplicate tests used identical path strings.
fix: Require the supplied path to equal its confined canonical relative path.
